title: FluxedMod; Alloyed
description: Adds several new Vanilla+ Tool Tiers!
body:
# FluxedMod; Alloyed
This mod adds 2 new alloys and tool tiers. (There will be more tiers in the future.)
## Alloys Added:
### Rose Gold
Has the Mining Speed of Gold, while having the Durability of Copper.
It can break the same blocks that Iron tools can.

![A hotbar that has all of the Rose Gold Tools, Ingot, Nugget and Block.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7006475ae09effd5bce8d702557cfa21eb1a4f6b.png)

![Crafting recipe for Rose Gold Blend.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6d92ffae587576a5b02cf68c390e77c97d40880.png)

### Fluxed Metal
Has a faster Mining Speed compared to Diamond, but has less durability and a lower Enchantablility.
It can break the same blocks that Diamond tools can. (It will be more interesting as this mod is worked on.)
The Fluxed Block has the same model as the Fiery Block from [The Twilight Forest](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest).

![A hotbar that has all of the Fluxed Tools, Ingot, Nugget and Block.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61e4caefc4665fb8373fc16355ac942c565c423f.png)

![Crafting recipe for Fluxed Blend.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fbaa0b075c54defea3c4b1a083bb0a41cd6bc648.png)

## How to get the Alloys
The first thing you need is a Stonecutter. Place your metal of choice (Iron, Gold and Copper) in the Stonecutter to turn it into Powder. With your snazzy new Metal Powder, you can mix it with other powders to make a variety of alloys (only 2 alloys)!

Smelt the Alloy Blend you make to create the Ingot. Then you simply create the tools like you normally would.
